name: ag-swarmer
description: AgentChat 群式多 Agent 协作工作台

scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm desktop:icons && pnpm desktop:backend && pnpm --filter @ag-swarmer/frontend tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm desktop:icons && pnpm desktop:backend && pnpm --filter @ag-swarmer/frontend tauri build && pnpm desktop:zip
scripts.desktop:backend: uv --directory backend run pyinstaller --noconsole --name ag-swarmer-backend --onefile --paths . --distpath dist --workpath build --specpath build --hidden-import app.main --collect-all langgraph --collect-all langgraph_checkpoint --collect-all langgraph_checkpoint_sqlite app/desktop_server.py && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('backend/dist/ag-swarmer-backend.exe','backend/dist/ag-swarmer-backend-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe')"
